title: ICICI Prudential introduces Swasthya Pension Scheme under PFRDA sandbox
summary: ICICI Prudential launched Swasthya Pension Scheme under PFRDA sandbox allowing up to 25% withdrawal for medical expenses via Apollo 24|7 (70-100% equity investment).
